name: (BETA) Drive A Kukirin!
desc:
🛴 DRIVE A KUKIRIN! | Realistic Electric Scooter Simulator

Experience one of the most realistic electric scooter games on Roblox! Ride powerful e-scooters, master wheelies, explore the open world, and experience realistic scooter physics.

🔥 FEATURES

🛴 Realistic Electric Scooters
⚡ Smooth & Realistic Driving Physics
🏍️ Skill-Based Wheelies
👀 First-Person Riding
🪖 Wearable Helmets
🌎 Open-World Exploration

Inspired by real electric scooter culture and popular scooters such as KuKirin, Ausom, Dualtron, Joyor, VSETT, Kaabo, Segway, Xiaomi, and more.

⚠️ EARLY BETA: The game is still in active development. Expect bugs, unfinished features, and frequent updates!

⭐ Favorite + Like the game for more scooters and updates!

Credits:
G3 Pro Model Made By: Tomhaus
